reason: The HIGH/CRITICAL findings in these paths belong to the upstream ORCE 2.0.13 runtime (its bundled Node-RED, palette and npm dependencies), to kubectl v1.35.8, the newest 1.35 patch release, and to Helm v4.3.0, the newest release, which upstream built with Go 1.27.1 and golang.org/x/net v0.57.0 (CVE-2026-78667, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-97031; fixed in Go 1.27.2 and x/net 0.60.0). They cannot be fixed in this project's layer without modifying the mandated upstream component. Everything this project adds stays under the scan gate.
tracking: Client confirmation of the exception and a rebuilt ORCE image from Eclipse XFSC requested through FACIS on 2026-09-23; the Helm entry was added on 2026-10-14 and awaits confirmation by FACIS, the client. Helm's 4.3.1 milestone (due 2026-10-14) builds with Go 1.27.2 but still carries x/net v0.57.0: drop /usr/local/bin/helm from skipFiles when the pin moves to a Helm release built with Go 1.27.2 or later and x/net 0.60.0 or later. Remove this file when the pin moves to a rebuilt ORCE and a patched kubectl.
